statements.name: Spec
statements.says: Each browser load follows the modeled migration steps within the checked bounds.

statements.name: DeleteOnlyWhenShared
statements.says: Deletion of the old database is requested only when every original local item is present in the shared library under the same kind and name.

statements.name: CompletionRequiresAllShared
statements.says: The completion flag is never set while any original local item is still absent from the shared library.

statements.name: CompletedLoadsQuiet
statements.says: A load that starts with the completion flag makes no upload, flag-write, or database-deletion attempt.

statements.name: NoStorageWork
statements.says: When reading local storage is unavailable, migration makes no upload, flag-write, or database-deletion attempt.

statements.name: NoAbsentLibraryCopy
statements.says: A browser with no old database uploads no items and requests no database deletion.

statements.name: UploadOnlyNewKeys
statements.says: An item is read for upload only if the shared-library listing lacks its exact kind and name.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: All stored values, migration phases, item sets, and observed operation counts stay within their declared types and bounds.

statements.name: CopiedAndCompleted
statements.says: Migration can upload local items, mark completion, and request deletion after every local item is shared.

statements.name: AlreadySharedCompleted
statements.says: Migration can finish without uploads when every local item already exists under its kind and name.

statements.name: LaterLoadQuiet
statements.says: A second load after completion can return without making any further writes.

statements.name: AbsentLibrarySkipped
statements.says: A load with no old database can record completion without uploading or deleting anything.

statements.name: AbsentStorageSkipped
statements.says: A load without readable local storage can return without writing anything.

statements.name: EmptyLibraryCompleted
statements.says: An existing empty local database can be marked complete and scheduled for deletion without uploads.

statements.name: UnreadableRetained
statements.says: An item with unreadable bytes can remain local with migration still eligible for a later load.

statements.name: FailedUploadRetained
statements.says: An item whose upload failed can remain local with migration still eligible for a later load.

statements.name: FailedItemRetried
statements.says: A second load can attempt to read an item left uncopied by a first-load read or upload failure.

statements.name: MetadataFailureRetained
statements.says: A metadata-read failure can leave an incomplete local library intact and unmarked for a later load.

statements.name: DeleteIncomplete
statements.says: Migration requests deletion while at least one local item has no shared copy.

statements.name: CompleteDespiteUnreadableBytes
statements.says: Migration proceeds to mark completion after silently skipping an unreadable item that has no shared copy.

statements.name: CompleteDespiteUploadFailure
statements.says: Migration proceeds to mark completion even though an upload failed and the item is still absent from the shared library.

statements.name: WriteAfterCompletion
statements.says: A later load writes the completion flag again despite finding it already set.

---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

\* ItemKeys lists local items in createdAt order; each key is <<kind, name>>.
\* Calls are sequential browser loads; API outcomes and flag writes may fail.
\* shared records the stub server's keys, and seen is one listHistory snapshot.
\* localItems records the original database; the function never removes one row.
\* deleteIssued records deleteDatabase invocation, not asynchronous completion.
\* writes counts attempted uploads, marker writes, and deletion requests.
\* retryItems records first-load failures still absent from the shared store.
\* No fairness is assumed for another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS ItemCount, MaxLoads, FirstKind, SecondKind, FirstName, SecondName

ItemKeys == [i \in 1..ItemCount |->
    <<IF i = 1 THEN FirstKind ELSE SecondKind, FirstName>>]

ServerKeys == {<<FirstKind, FirstName>>, <<SecondKind, FirstName>>,
    <<FirstKind, SecondName>>}
VARIABLES storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems

vars == <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

Items == 1..ItemCount

Phases == {"idle", "flag", "open", "metadata", "list", "scan", "read",
    "upload", "mark", "markEmpty", "delete", "return"}

WriteCounts == [upload : 0..(ItemCount * MaxLoads),
    mark : 0..MaxLoads, delete : 0..MaxLoads]

ZeroWrites == [upload |-> 0, mark |-> 0, delete |-> 0]

Current == CHOOSE i \in todo : \A j \in todo : i <= j

Missing == {i \in localItems : ItemKeys[i] \notin shared}

AllShared == Missing = {}

TypeOK ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in SUBSET Items
    /\ shared \in SUBSET ServerKeys
    /\ flag \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deleteIssued \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ loads \in 0..MaxLoads
    /\ todo \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ seen \in SUBSET ServerKeys
    /\ unreadable \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ failed \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ metadataOK \in BOOLEAN
    /\ writes \in WriteCounts
    /\ entryDone \in BOOLEAN
    /\ entryWrites \in WriteCounts
    /\ retryItems \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ (phase \in {"read", "upload"} => todo # {})

DeleteOnlyWhenShared == deleteIssued => AllShared

CompletionRequiresAllShared == flag => AllShared

CompletedLoadsQuiet == entryDone => writes = entryWrites

NoStorageWork == ~storage => writes = ZeroWrites

NoAbsentLibraryCopy ==
    ~oldDatabase => (writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0)

UploadOnlyNewKeys ==
    phase \in {"read", "upload"} => ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen

CopiedAndCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ AllShared
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload > 0

AlreadySharedCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload = 0

UnreadableRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ unreadable \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedUploadRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ failed \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedItemRetried ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ loads = 2
    /\ Current \in retryItems

LaterLoadQuiet ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 2 /\ entryDone
    /\ writes = entryWrites

AbsentLibrarySkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~oldDatabase /\ flag
    /\ writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0

AbsentStorageSkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~storage
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites

EmptyLibraryCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ oldDatabase /\ localItems = {}
    /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ writes.upload = 0

MetadataFailureRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ ~metadataOK /\ Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

Init ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in {1..n : n \in 0..ItemCount}
    /\ (~oldDatabase => localItems = {})
    /\ shared \in SUBSET ServerKeys
    /\ flag = FALSE /\ deleteIssued = FALSE
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 0
    /\ todo = {} /\ seen = {} /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
    /\ metadataOK = TRUE
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites /\ entryDone = FALSE /\ entryWrites = ZeroWrites
    /\ retryItems = {}

StartLoad ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads < MaxLoads
    /\ loads' = loads + 1 /\ phase' = "flag"
    /\ entryDone' = flag /\ entryWrites' = writes
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK, writes, retryItems>>

ReadFlag ==
    /\ phase = "flag"
    /\ phase' = IF ~storage \/ flag THEN "return" ELSE "open"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ seen' = {} /\ unreadable' = {} /\ failed' = {}
    /\ metadataOK' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

NoDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ ~oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "markEmpty"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenError ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenThrows ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadMetadata ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = localItems /\ metadataOK' = TRUE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MetadataError ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ metadataOK' = FALSE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListShared ==
    /\ phase = "list"
    /\ seen' = shared /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListError ==
    /\ phase = "list" /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

SkipExisting ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \in seen
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

StartRead ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen
    /\ phase' = "read"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadBytes ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ phase' = "upload"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

BytesUnavailable ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ unreadable' = unreadable \union {Current}
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadSuccess ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ shared' = shared \union {ItemKeys[Current]}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ failed' = failed \union {Current}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

FinishItems ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {}
    /\ phase' = IF metadataOK /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
        THEN "mark" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MarkerWritten ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ flag' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = IF phase = "mark" /\ failed = {} THEN "delete" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MarkerError ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1] /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

DeleteDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "delete"
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.delete = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReturnFromLoad ==
    /\ phase = "return" /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ retryItems' = IF loads = 1
        THEN (unreadable \union failed) \intersect Missing ELSE retryItems
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites>>

Idle == phase = "idle" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ StartLoad \/ ReadFlag \/ OpenDatabase \/ NoDatabase \/ OpenError \/ OpenThrows
    \/ ReadMetadata \/ MetadataError \/ ListShared \/ ListError
    \/ SkipExisting \/ StartRead \/ ReadBytes \/ BytesUnavailable
    \/ UploadSuccess \/ UploadFailure \/ FinishItems
    \/ MarkerWritten \/ MarkerError \/ DeleteDatabase \/ ReturnFromLoad \/ Idle

DeleteIncomplete ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ ~AllShared
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.delete = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

CompleteDespiteUnreadableBytes ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ unreadable \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

CompleteDespiteUploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ failed \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

WriteAfterCompletion ==
    /\ phase = "flag" /\ entryDone /\ writes.mark < MaxLoads
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in {1..n : n \in 0..ItemCount}
    /\ (~oldDatabase => localItems = {})
    /\ shared \in SUBSET ServerKeys
    /\ flag = FALSE /\ deleteIssued = FALSE
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 0
    /\ todo = {} /\ seen = {} /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
    /\ metadataOK = TRUE
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites /\ entryDone = FALSE /\ entryWrites = ZeroWrites
    /\ retryItems = {}

StartLoad ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads < MaxLoads
    /\ loads' = loads + 1 /\ phase' = "flag"
    /\ entryDone' = flag /\ entryWrites' = writes
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK, writes, retryItems>>

ReadFlag ==
    /\ phase = "flag"
    /\ phase' = IF ~storage \/ flag THEN "return" ELSE "open"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ seen' = {} /\ unreadable' = {} /\ failed' = {}
    /\ metadataOK' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

NoDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ ~oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "markEmpty"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenError ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "markEmpty"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenThrows ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadMetadata ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = localItems /\ metadataOK' = TRUE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MetadataError ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ metadataOK' = FALSE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListShared ==
    /\ phase = "list"
    /\ seen' = shared /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListError ==
    /\ phase = "list" /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

SkipExisting ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \in seen
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

StartRead ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen
    /\ phase' = "read"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadBytes ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ phase' = "upload"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

BytesUnavailable ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ unreadable' = unreadable \union {Current}
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadSuccess ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ shared' = shared \union {ItemKeys[Current]}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ failed' = failed \union {Current}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

FinishItems ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MarkerWritten ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ flag' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = IF phase = "mark" /\ failed = {} THEN "delete" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MarkerError ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1] /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

DeleteDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "delete"
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.delete = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReturnFromLoad ==
    /\ phase = "return" /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ retryItems' = IF loads = 1
        THEN (unreadable \union failed) \intersect Missing ELSE retryItems
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites>>

Idle == phase = "idle" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ StartLoad \/ ReadFlag \/ OpenDatabase \/ NoDatabase \/ OpenError \/ OpenThrows
    \/ ReadMetadata \/ MetadataError \/ ListShared \/ ListError
    \/ SkipExisting \/ StartRead \/ ReadBytes \/ BytesUnavailable
    \/ UploadSuccess \/ UploadFailure \/ FinishItems
    \/ MarkerWritten \/ MarkerError \/ DeleteDatabase \/ ReturnFromLoad \/ Idle

DeleteAfterUploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "return" /\ flag /\ failed # {}
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.delete = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

WriteAfterCompletion ==
    /\ phase = "flag" /\ entryDone /\ writes.mark < MaxLoads
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: Each browser load follows the modeled migration steps within the checked bounds.

pins.name: NoDeletionAfterUploadFailure
pins.says: A database-deletion request is made only when the migration observed no rejected upload.

pins.name: CompletedLoadsQuiet
pins.says: A load that starts with the completion flag makes no upload, flag-write, or database-deletion attempt.

pins.name: NoStorageWork
pins.says: When reading local storage is unavailable, migration makes no upload, flag-write, or database-deletion attempt.

pins.name: NoAbsentLibraryCopy
pins.says: A browser with no old database uploads no items and requests no database deletion.

pins.name: UploadOnlyNewKeys
pins.says: An item is read for upload only if the shared-library listing lacks its exact kind and name.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: All stored values, migration phases, item sets, and observed operation counts stay within their declared types and bounds.

pins.name: CopiedAndCompleted
pins.says: Migration can upload local items, mark completion, and request deletion after every local item is shared.

pins.name: AlreadySharedCompleted
pins.says: Migration can finish without uploads when every local item already exists under its kind and name.

pins.name: LaterLoadQuiet
pins.says: A second load after completion can return without making any further writes.

pins.name: AbsentLibrarySkipped
pins.says: A load with no old database can record completion without uploading or deleting anything.

pins.name: AbsentStorageSkipped
pins.says: A load without readable local storage can return without writing anything.

pins.name: EmptyLibraryCompleted
pins.says: An existing empty local database can be marked complete and scheduled for deletion without uploads.

pins.name: UnreadableCanBeDeleted
pins.says: The migration can mark completion and delete a local library even when an unreadable item has no shared copy.

pins.name: FailedUploadCanBeAbandoned
pins.says: A failed upload can leave the local library intact but permanently skipped by later loads because completion was recorded.

pins.name: MetadataFailureCanDelete
pins.says: A metadata-read failure can be treated as an empty library and lead to deletion of items that have no shared copies.

pins.name: OpenFailureCanComplete
pins.says: An IndexedDB open error can record completion even when an existing local library still contains unshared items.

pins.name: DeleteAfterUploadFailure
pins.says: Migration requests deletion even though an upload was rejected.

pins.name: WriteAfterCompletion
pins.says: A later load writes the completion flag again despite finding it already set.
